ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a quadrilateral kite WXYZ, W is above, Y is below, Z is on the left, X is on the right; segment ZX horizontally passes through interior point U, segment WY vertically passes through U. According to the given method, regard ZX as the horizontal axis-of-symmetry diagonal of the kite, therefore the opposite angles at vertices W and Y are equal. Reasoning: Given m∠WXY = 13x + 24, m∠WZY = 35, m∠ZWX = 13x + 14. By the kite property, m∠ZYX = m∠ZWX = 13x + 14. The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is 360°, so (13x + 24) + 35 + (13x + 14) + (13x + 14) = 360. Combining gives 39x + 87 = 360, therefore 39x = 273, x = 7. Thus m∠ZYX = 13(7) + 14 = 91 + 14 = 105.

raw_record.question_text: WXYZ is a kite. If $m\angle WXY = 13x + 24$, $m\angle WZY = 35$, and $m\angle ZWX = 13x + 14$, find $m\angle ZYX$.

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram: W is the top vertex, Y is the bottom vertex, Z and X are left/right, and diagonal ZX is the horizontal symmetry diagonal of the kite, so the opposite angles at W and Y are congruent. From the text, take m∠WXY = 13x + 24, m∠WZY = 35, and m∠ZWX = 13x + 14. Use the kite property m∠ZYX = m∠ZWX, then apply the quadrilateral angle sum: (13x + 24) + 35 + (13x + 14) + (13x + 14) = 360. Solve x = 7, then m∠ZYX = 13x + 14 = 105.

推理：已知 m∠WXY = 13x + 24，m∠WZY = 35，m∠ZWX = 13x + 14。由风筝性质，m∠ZYX = m∠ZWX = 13x + 14。四边形内角和为 360°，所以 (13x + 24) + 35 + (13x + 14) + (13x + 14) = 360。合并得 39x + 87 = 360，因此 39x = 273，x = 7。于是 m∠ZYX = 13(7) + 14 = 91 + 14 = 105。

method.method_draft: From the image, view diagonal ZX as the kite’s symmetry diagonal dividing the kite into top triangle ZWX and bottom triangle ZYX. Because ZX bisects the angles at Z and X, the angle in triangle ZWX at Z is 35/2 and the angle at X is (13x + 24)/2. In triangle ZWX, use the triangle angle sum: 35/2 + (13x + 24)/2 + (13x + 14) = 180. Solve x = 7. Then by reflection symmetry across ZX, triangle ZWX matches triangle ZYX, so ∠ZYX corresponds to ∠ZWX and equals 13x + 14 = 105.

推理：因为 ZX 是对称对角线，所以它平分 Z 点和 X 点的角。因此在三角形 ZWX 中，Z 处角为 35/2，X 处角为 (13x + 24)/2，W 处角为 13x + 14。利用三角形内角和：35/2 + (13x + 24)/2 + (13x + 14) = 180。两边乘以 2 得 35 + 13x + 24 + 26x + 28 = 360，所以 39x + 87 = 360，39x = 273，x = 7。于是 ∠ZWX = 13x + 14 = 13(7) + 14 = 105。由关于 ZX 的对称性，三角形 ZWX 与三角形 ZYX 对应，∠ZYX 对应 ∠ZWX，所以 m∠ZYX = 105。
